item.title: Rallying Cry – October 4, 2026
item.description: Scientists found a way to help damaged retinas heal, volunteers in Singapore are learning to support isolated seniors, and Ukraine delivered aid to a hard-hit region again—plus, Stevie Wonder’s legacy shines bright in a new feature!
